title: Pips Irish Lamb and Barley Stew
ingredients: 300g (10.5oz) lamb leg steaks, fat trimmed away, chopped quite small
2 potatoes (total weight about 300g), peeled and cut into bite-sized chunks
method: Preheat the oven to 180°C/160°C fan (350°F), Gas Mark 4.
Spray a large flameproof casserole pot (with a lid) with oil. Fry the lamb for 2 minutes, then add the onion, leeks, celery and garlic. Fry over a medium heat for 8 minutes.
Add the hot stock, barley, carrots, potatoes, tomato purée, mustard, rosemary and thyme and season. Stir everything together well.
Put the lid on the pan and place on to the middle shelf of the oven for 1.5 hours. The sauce should be thick and rich and the lamb pieces tender. Serve scattered with parsley.
notes: Try adding swede, turnip, butternut squash or sweet potato. Lean diced beef works as an alternative to lamb. Replace 500ml of stock with stout for a tasty twist (increases calorie count).
